rag.text:
Test: TC-5314 — Jira Team - Global teams - Team creation, synchronization and re-synchronization
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/Jira Team
Labels: teamextplatform

Description:
TC includes steps that allow verifying the creation, synchronization, and re-synchronization of a team based on Jira Team.

Steps:
1. Create a connection using TC-5310 as a guide and prepare a Jira team consisting of at least 3 members
   Data: teamNameJira: TC-5314 Team
   Expected: The connection is successfully established, the team has been created.
2. Navigate to 'Global Teams' and select 'Create new team based on Jira Team' (the option visible after expanding the dropdown).
   Expected: A modal will open with the option to select a Jira Team
3. Select a Jira Team
   Data: teamNameJira: TC-5314 Team
   Expected: The following fields are automatically filled: BP team name, team code, and the start date of Team memberships with the date on which you perform the test
4. Select the 'Create' button
   Expected: The team has been created, and the 'Jira Team' label is now visible
5. Click on the created team and verify the data
   Data: teamNameJira: TC-5314 Team
   Expected: The team member list matches the list of team members in Jira
6. On a separate tab, add a new member to the team in Jira
   Expected: The new team member has been added
7. Return to BP and perform the synchronization
   Expected: The team member list has been updated and is now consistent with the team member list in Jira
8. Add a new member to the team in BP
   Expected: The new team member is visible on the list in BP. The option for re-synchronization has appeared, along with an additional ‘pen' icon. Hovering over the 'pen icon’ shows information about the possibility of performing re-synchronization
9. Check if the user added from BP to the team member list appears on the team member list in Jira
   Expected: The user is not visible on the team member list in Jira
10. Perform the re-synchronization in BP
   Expected: The user added from BP disappears from the team member list in BP
11. On a separate tab, add a new member to the team in Jira
   Expected: The new team member has been added
12. Return to BP and perform the synchronization
   Expected: The team member list has been updated and is now consistent with the team member list in Jira
